_note: One config per group (ARCHITECTURE §5). Slug `group_id` is load-bearing — it is the output path site/data/<group_id>/ and the URL. `display_name` is cosmetic.
_count_conference_championship_note: Per-group rule (ARCHITECTURE §1/§5): do conference-championship wins settle into a team's season win total? Sportsbooks differ, so it is per-group config, not a code constant. CFBD returns conf-title games as seasonType=regular; the shared cache tags them but excludes nothing — this flag decides. Default false.
_pick_rules_note: Settled format (LOCKED), enforced by validate_team_names.py per group: EXACTLY 4 picks per manager, spanning 3 distinct conferences. Always enforced — no unenforced path. The minimum was 4 here through 2026-08-21; that was config drift from the documented league rule of 3, corrected before the real draft was entered. The other three groups still read 4 and have NOT been reconciled — do not assume this value is league-wide.
_conference_minimum_waivers_note: Per-manager exemptions from min_distinct_conferences ONLY — every other draft rule still applies to a waived manager, and every manager not named here still hard-fails the gate. Opt-in: an absent or empty list waives nobody. Each applied waiver prints a WAIVED: line on every validator run, so a roster scored against something other than the written rule says so in the output that scored it. Do not add an entry here to paper over a bad draft — it is a record of a commissioner decision, not a fix.
_managers_note: Locked real identities; remaining managers added at draft. `manager_id` is the stable join key everywhere — never displayed. `display_name` is cosmetic. `email` per manager (recipient list derives from these when email_enabled).
